cf_directional.label: Directional CF
cf_directional.formula: fixed base plus sign-specific clipped train C/D times partner-minus-base

best_single.label: Best Single · hindsight
best_single.formula: lower event-averaged Brier-score constituent per test fold, not a per-target oracle

split.unit: source + event_id, shared across dates and horizons

aggregation.diversity: train-target weighted fold diagnostics; null if any included fold metric is undefined; exact constant vectors have undefined correlation
aggregation.brier_score: within each fold, average squared error within event and then equally across events; combine folds by event count
aggregation.brier_index: 100 * (1 - sqrt(Brier score)), transformed once after event averaging
aggregation.gain: relative reduction in event-equal ordinary Brier score
aggregation.near_bi: filter individual training folds before aggregation
